title: crynta/terax-ai
claim: crynta/terax-ai — Lightweight (7MB) Terminal-first AI-native dev workspace
why_good: A 7MB terminal-native AI dev workspace — bets devs want a fast, local CLI over heavy AI IDEs.
value: Charge teams for a pro/enterprise tier (shared config, SSO, private models) on a free lightweight core.
risk: Crowded terminal-agent space (Aider, Claude Code, Codex); 'lightweight' alone rarely holds a moat.
pick_reason: The project offers a specific product that caters to a niche market of developers, allowing for monetization through subscriptions or licensing.
